revision.proxy_revision_caveat: V58 0% success is NOT evidence that MINT cannot learn. It IS evidence of L2 observation bugs (gripper_joint frozen + images near-white). Fix data first.

finding_1_gripper_joint_frozen.description: V58 state[7] (gripper_joint) frozen at -0.042 across ALL 18,701 frames
finding_1_gripper_joint_frozen.mechanism: drawer_robot_env.py has continuous gripper fix, drawer_robot_env_lerobot.py does NOT. All V58 recording uses lerobot path.
finding_1_gripper_joint_frozen.downstream: MINT state tokenizer produces identical tokens for gripper_joint → zero gripper signal → model relies on vision encoder
finding_1_gripper_joint_frozen.fix: Apply same continuous gripper conversion to drawer_robot_env_lerobot.py → _state_vector()

finding_2_near_white_images.description: V58 rendered images are near-white (mean=[0.976,0.976,0.976], std=[0.003,0.003,0.003])
finding_2_near_white_images.mechanism: PyBullet ERendered outputting blank/white frames. Likely ER_TINY_RENDERER headless configuration issue.
finding_2_near_white_images.downstream: Vision encoder pretrained on LIBERO realistic scenes receives white noise → cannot learn scene structure or gripper state
finding_2_near_white_images.fix: Verify ERendered camera capture. Check lighting, renderer backend, and scene geometry export.

finding_3_data_volume_correction.correction: next_actions.json previously stated 1,301 frames — this was pre-V58 recovery era. Actual V58: 18,701 frames, 229 episodes.
finding_3_data_volume_correction.impact: More data does NOT help — all 18,701 frames are corrupted (frozen gripper + near-white images). Fix the bug first.

finding_4_action_normalization_correct.description: Action normalization is correct — NOT the root cause
finding_4_action_normalization_correct.evidence: MINT output: IDENTITY normalization, no de-normalization. V58 action distributions (translation max=0.55, rotation max=0.14) within clipping range.
finding_4_action_normalization_correct.mechanism: clip action[:3] to [-1,1] → multiply by 0.03m/step. clip action[3:6] to [-1,1] → multiply by 0.25rad/step. gripper: >=0 → open, <0 → close.
finding_4_action_normalization_correct.verdict: Action normalization is NOT the root cause of V58 0%.

finding_5_pretrain_eq_finetune.description: Both pretrained and finetuned MINT = 0% — confirms L2 data bug
finding_5_pretrain_eq_finetune.mechanism: Pretrained MINT: trained on LIBERO where state[7] varies → sees constant -0.042 → degenerate embeddings. Finetuned MINT: trained on V58 corrupted data → learned to ignore state[7] + vision input = white noise → no useful gripper signal.
finding_5_pretrain_eq_finetune.verdict: 0% is NOT a test of MINT's learning capacity — it's a test of data quality.
